text:
Priya (PM): quick async — Q2 OKR milestone tally. Please call out: what actually shipped, what slipped, and a 1-line next step + owner for the model-routing/runtime rollout.
Kevin (Eng): Shipped: batching v1 -> prod, prefix KV cache enabled for 3 routes, cost dashboard updated. Slipped: model-routing canary (blocked by infra GPU quota) and the runtime-v2 latency regressions on long seqs. Next step: unblock infra quota request — owner @Maria (Platform).
Maria (Platform): Confirming I raised the quota request earlier today (ticket INF-3421). Need approval on region placement from @Jay (SRE) due to peering/CIDR limits. ETA for approval: 24h if no network changes.
Jay (SRE): I can approve but we need a maintenance window to avoid routing flaps. Suggest Thurs 02:00–04:00 UTC. If that's ok @Priya we'll slot it. Also note: will need a small firewall rule change (security review flagged it).
Anita (Eng-ML): Heads-up — we observed a quality regression on the canary for a 2% subset of prompts after quantization tweaks. Rolled the model back to v1.2 for the canary. Next step: run the focused eval set and diff with v1.2. Owner: @Anita.
Kevin (Eng): Added quick repro command for the canary health check:
```
# check canary pods
kubectl get pods -n runtime-canary -l app=runtime-canary
# tail logs
kubectl logs -f deploy/runtime-canary -n runtime-canary
```
Kevin (Eng): Also added a small feature toggle so we can route 10% of traffic to fallback-model until we confirm fixes.
Priya (PM): Thanks. Quick ownership summary from thread — please react with :thumbsup: if correct or correct by reply:
- Unblock infra quota + region placement -> Maria (Platform)
- Maintenance window + security change -> Jay (SRE)
- Eval + regression triage -> Anita (Eng-ML)
- Canary rollout + toggle -> Kevin (Eng)
Maria (Platform): :thumbsup: I'll follow up in INF-3421 with the network diagram and ask for expedited review.
Jay (SRE): :eyes: I'll drop a runbook snippet in the incident runbooks repo and tag @Kevin once scheduled.
Anita (Eng-ML): I'll start the eval run now and share the first diff in ~2 hours.
Priya (PM): Final ask — if teams can post 1-line progress updates here as they happen, I'll collate for the weekly exec OKR update. Example: "Maria: quota approved, scheduled maintenance Thu 02:00–04:00 UTC". Thanks everyone.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: snapshot: runtime-batching-v1 deployed to prod at 1769123468 :rocket:
Kevin (Eng): Noted. I'll also open a short PR with the fallback toggle config and ping for review.
